name: Rupiah Token
oneLiner: IDRT is PT Rupiah Token Indonesia's centralized rupiah stablecoin, backed 1:1 by IDR bank deposits and KYC-gated for direct issuance and redemption.
collateral: Indonesian rupiah bank deposits held 1:1 by PT Rupiah Token Indonesia; issuer materials describe full fiat backing with regular bank reporting
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 issuance and redemption through PT Rupiah Token Indonesia after KYC; the issuer publishes bank-reporting and smart-contract audit materials

mintAuthority.summary: IDRT is issued by PT Rupiah Token Indonesia; all 1:1 mint and redemption runs through the issuer's KYC-gated centralized backend against IDR bank deposits.

controls.label: PT Rupiah Token Indonesia issuance backend
controls.evidence: PT Rupiah Token Indonesia operates centralized KYC-gated mint and redeem against custodied IDR bank deposits; a single regulated issuer controls supply creation.

review.evidence: Issuer materials and monthly CPA attestations describe IDRT as a centralized fiat-backed token with 1:1 issuer-operated mint/redeem after KYC; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classification based on the centralized issuer model described in project materials; on-chain token owner/minter admin across Ethereum, BSC, Harmony, and Polygon was not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain token owner/minter admin and any proxy admin for IDRT across its deployments before raising confidence.
